verdict.rationale: vLLM is driven entirely from the command line: a CLI command starts the OpenAI-compatible API server, there is an official Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai) for deployment, and it installs via pip/uv with offline-inference and CLI benchmark modes. Together these show it runs headless on servers with no GUI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of headless/CI-pipeline usage (e.g., CI recipes), and independent hands-on corroboration of running it in CI.
